name: Pecunia Wallet Payment Gateway
author: pecunia

sections.installation:
WooCommerce plugin extension has to be installed and enabled.
1. Download latest release from github or WordPress marketplace.
2. Install and activate plugin.
3. Go to WooCommerce Settings > Payments, configure and enable the gateway.
4. That’s it!
sections.description:
Accept BTC, BCH, LTC, and DOGE non-custodial and direct to your wallet. Fully automated crypto payments with 0% processing fees.

Key Features

  • Easy setup: open your wallet and start accepting money on your website immediately.
  • Absolutely free: no setup fee, no maintenance fee, no withdrawal fee, no buyer fee.
  • Non-custodial system: all money is completely under your control.
  • You can issue invoices in USD, EUR, JPY or in cryptocurrencies.
  • You can not only accept money, but also make mass payments.
  • No chargebacks: all funds received are guaranteed to be yours.
  • You can access your funds in other wallets if necessary.
  • No KYC or AML: the wallet cannot control users.
  • Fully automatic. Works worldwide.

Support

We are happy to answer any questions you may have. Open a ticket here.

External services

It creates and tracks invoices using provided settings values.
